'''Jordi Rubio Gómez''' (born 1 November 1987) is an [[Andorra]]n international [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)|defender]] for [[FC Santa Coloma]].<ref name="soccerway">{{Soccerway|55889}}</ref>

==Career==
Rubio began his senior career at [[FC Andorra]] in 2006, before moving to [[UE Santa Coloma|Santa Coloma]] in 2008.

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2006.
